description: This Java abstract class defines an event related to loan delinquency range changes within the Fineract project. It implements the Event interface parametrized with LoanAccountDelinquencyRangeDataV1 and provides methods to retrieve the data class and an ID extractor function.

classes.name: AbstractLoanDelinquencyRangeChangeEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a loan delinquency range change event, implementing the Event interface with specific data type.

methods.name: getDataClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the event data, LoanAccountDelinquencyRangeDataV1.

methods.name: getIdExtractor
methods.description: Returns a Function that extracts the Loan ID as a Long from the LoanAccountDelinquencyRangeDataV1 data object.
